app_tagline: Bite, carry, and head for the nest.
app_description: A board game about capturing enemy crocodiles, hauling them to your nest, and scoring 3 points
panel_mission_detail: Capture an enemy special crocodile, carry it to your nest, and feed.
panel_rule_vitality_detail: 2 per turn. Only 1 on the first player's first turn.
action_rematch: Play again with the same setup
select_prompt_detail: Legal destinations and targets light up.
no_legal_actions: No action is possible with the vitality left.
match_result_replay_link: Result and replay for this match
landing_log_restarted: New terrain revealed. Start your setup.
landing_deploy_zone_error: Choose a cell in your own near zone that is not a nest.
play_lead: Find an opponent through random matchmaking.
play_matched: Opponent found. Taking you to the match…
log_ticket_failed: Could not obtain a connection ticket
home_intro: Both players command the same 8 crocodiles. Capture, haul, and feed to reach 3 points first.
home_start_detail: You can play right away without signing up. A guest's record can be carried over when you create an account later.
home_guest_notice: A guest session expires after 7 days and cannot be restored. Create an account to keep your record; your current record and settings are carried over.
home_unverified_notice: Your email address is not verified yet. You can still play, but password resets need a working address.
signup_lead: Keep your match history and replays.
signup_guest_notice: Your current guest record and settings are carried over to this account as you sign up.
signup_email_help: We will send a confirmation email. You can play before confirming.
forgot_sent_notice: If that address is registered, a reset link is on its way. The link is valid for 15 minutes and can be used once.
reset_invalid_token: The link has expired or has already been used. Please request a new one.
reset_password_help: At least {min} characters. Setting it signs you out on every other device.
history_empty: No matches recorded yet. Finished matches show up here.
replay_not_ready: The replay is being prepared. It becomes available a few minutes after the match ends.
replay_pending: It is not stored yet. Please try again in a moment.
report_lead: Tell the operators about harassment or other problems with this opponent. A report alone never triggers an automatic penalty.
report_received: Your report was received. The operators will review it.
error_guest_start_failed: Could not start as a guest.
error_password_too_short: The password must be at least {min} characters.
error_signup_unexpected: Something went wrong while signing up.
error_invalid_credentials: That email address or password is not correct.
error_login_unexpected: Something went wrong while logging in.
error_reset_link_invalid: That reset link is not valid. Please start again.
error_reset_expired: The link has expired or has already been used.
error_reset_unexpected: Something went wrong while resetting the password.
error_captcha_failed: The bot check failed. Please try again.
error_guest_rate_limited: Too many guest sessions from this connection. Wait a while or create an account.
error_auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
error_password_compromised: That password appears in known breaches. Please choose another one.
error_two_factor_invalid: That verification code is not correct.
two_factor_description: Enter the six-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
admin_mfa_required: The admin area requires two-factor authentication. Please enable it.
admin_mfa_intro: Enter your current password to reveal the details to register in your authenticator app.
admin_mfa_uri_label: URI to register in your authenticator app
admin_mfa_verify_intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish enabling it.
admin_audit_notice: Every view and action on this screen is recorded in admin_audit.
